summary: v67.1 P0 Bug Fix Verified - All features tested successfully. No insertBefore crashes detected during tab navigation or DAMA kit generation. Static containers, dynamic currency prefix, and direct download link all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: v67.1 ErrorBoundary wrapper correctly implemented at App level (lines 15-47)
Static containers with IDs (tab-container-search, tab-container-lists, etc.) using display:block/none instead of conditional rendering - prevents insertBefore errors
Currency prefix dynamically changes: R$ for BRL, $ for USD (line 1527)
Download button is correctly an <a href={blobUrl}> tag with data-testid='download-zip-btn' (lines 1692-1700)
Nova Proposta reset correctly clears all form state including blob URL cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: v67.1 fully verified. All P0 bug fixes working. HC IMPORTAÇÕES has timbrado 'modelo hc Dama.docx'. Static containers prevent insertBefore errors. Currency prefix changes dynamically. Download is direct <a href> link.

P0_insertBefore_crash_fix.details: No console errors during tab navigation or DAMA kit generation. Static containers with display:block/none prevent React DOM manipulation conflicts.

static_containers.details: All 6 tab containers exist in DOM with IDs: tab-container-search, tab-container-lists, tab-container-radar, tab-container-dama, tab-container-precos, tab-container-settings. Switching tabs shows/hides via CSS display property.

dynamic_currency_prefix.details: Currency dropdown changes between BRL and USD. Value field prefix changes from 'R$' to '$' accordingly. Tested both directions.

DAMA_full_flow.details: Complete flow tested: Select HC IMPORTAÇÕES (with timbrado), fill item=1 value=100, upload PDF, click GERAR KIT LICITAÇÃO, success screen appears with all stats.

ZIP_download_link.details: Download button is <a> tag with data-testid='download-zip-btn', href='blob:...' URL, and download attribute with filename. Verified tag is 'A' not 'BUTTON'.

nova_proposta_reset.details: Clicking 'Nova Proposta' resets form: clears item number, value, uploaded files. Form returns to initial state.

tab_navigation_after_kit.details: After generating kit, navigating through all tabs (Pesquisa, Minhas Listas, Radares, Preços, DAMA IA) works without errors.

test_runs.details: Tag: A, href: blob:..., download: kit_licitacao_item1_*.zip
Item field and value field reset to empty

rca_of_the_issue.bug_description: React 'insertBefore' crash when navigating tabs and generating DAMA kit
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: v66.0 identified programmatic download (.click()) during React state update caused DOM manipulation conflict. v67.1 adds static containers to prevent conditional rendering issues.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_implemented: v67.1 implements: 1) ErrorBoundary wrapper, 2) Static containers with IDs using display:block/none instead of conditional rendering, 3) Keys prefixed for stable React reconciliation, 4) Direct <a href> link for download
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Tested complete DAMA flow multiple times with tab navigation - no console errors, all features working correctly
